text:
Evan Brooks: Heads-up — MeridianHealth approved their PO but legal returned an MSA redline + a DPA with a KMS attestation request. They're eager to kick off the POC this week. Can we proceed with provisioning?
Priya Kapoor: We can provision for a limited POC if customer signs the order form and agrees to a 14-day DPA cure period. KMS attestation is a separate addendum — we can't promise HSM/KMS in the OF.
Hannah Wu: Finance asks: do we need a fully executed DPA to issue the first invoice? Jared?
Jared Cole: Billing can accept a signed OF + customer PO for initial invoice, but we must add a billing caveat: "Provisioning & invoicing subject to DPA execution within 14 days." If DPA not returned, we'll suspend future provisioning and invoices.
Priya Kapoor: Legal will accept the caveat but needs Appendix A attached with customer redlines and a one-time SLA deviation note for the POC. I'll sign once Appendix A is included.
legal-bot: Template check: order_form_v4 requires fields: billing_entity, customer_po_number, payment_terms, sku_lines, poc_sla_note. Add Appendix A file id.
Evan Brooks: Customer prefers vendor-signs-first. Can we set DocuSign to that?
Hannah Wu: Yes — will create envelope vendor-first and include contracts@redwood.com as signer 1, then exec@meridianhealth.com. I'll attach the customer's redline PDF.
Maya Singh: Meridian here — we can sign vendor-first. KMS attestation will be supplied within 10 business days. Exec contact: legal@meridianhealth.com.
Priya Kapoor: Approving one-time POC SLA: uptime 95% for 30 days. Add line: "This POC SLA applies only during initial 30-day provisioning period; full SLA contingent on DPA execution."
Hannah Wu: Envelope created at 3101234578 — DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelope/meridian-9876. Routing: contracts@redwood.com -> legal@meridianhealth.com.
Evan Brooks: Summary: PO 67890, envelope meridian-9876, OF signed vendor-first, provisioning OK pending DPA within 14 days. I'll monitor and flag if DPA not returned by 2026-04-12.
Jared Cole: Noted for billing. Will not process subsequent invoices if DPA not executed.
Priya Kapoor: Thanks team. I'll attach Appendix A and sign when present.
Maya Singh: We'll upload the DPA redlines to the envelope within 48 hours. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
